en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Mansour Bin Al Abbas, from Ali Bin Asbaat, from Suleyman Bin Abu Zaynab, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘My<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> was saying: ‘If there was a road for me<sup>asws</sup> to my<sup>asws</sup> house from Mina, I<sup>asws</sup> would not enter Makkah’.
en.sarwar: 9. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Mansur ibn al-‘Abbas from Ali ibn Asbat from Sulayman ibn abu Zaynabah from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
My father, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, would say, “Had there been a road to my home from Mina’ I would not enter Makkah.’””
